title: Cảnh Sobi Garden: 3 ô đất, Vòi tưới, Máy xay, Thùng ủ
decisions: The three plots are one bed in three states (shared fit, same scale): dry, watered, not yet unlocked; the bed shape follows the Farm veggie patch (wooden frame). Buildings stand on the Farm grass patch (same rule as Farm). The Feed Mill is a small wooden mill house with a millstone, not the Farm windmill, so the two never read as the same building; the Composter is a slatted wooden compost bin (it turns pig manure into fertilizer). GardenScene still paints its ground in code: a bg_garden backdrop is not in the manifest and not part of this batch.

sheets.name: L
sheets.title: Ô đất: khô / ướt / chưa mở

hints.what: the garden bed with a low wooden frame (only the bed shape, not the cabbages)

sheets.notes: All three are the same empty garden bed, the same size and shape: a soft rounded rectangle of tilled soil with three shallow furrows, a low wooden plank frame, seen three-quarter from above, wider than tall. Nothing grows on it; the bed IS the object.

cells.desc: Dry plot: light warm-brown crumbly soil
Watered plot: the same bed with dark rich brown damp soil, two small shiny water glints in the furrows
Locked plot: the same bed overgrown with a few weed tufts and two small grey stones, soil dull and pale, one frame plank loose

sheets.name: W
sheets.title: Vòi tưới + Máy xay + Thùng ủ

hints.what: the blue water pump and stone well (colour and material of the water parts)

cells.desc: Sprinkler: a slim tall garden sprinkler, a blue metal pipe on a little wooden post with a round rotating head on top spraying three soft arcs of water droplets; clearly taller than wide

Feed Mill: a small cosy wooden mill house with a red shingle roof, a big round grey millstone turning beside it under a little roof, a wooden chute pouring golden feed into a burlap sack, two grain sacks stacked by the door; about as wide as tall

Composter: a sturdy wooden compost bin made of slatted planks with a hinged lid half open, dark compost and a few green leaf scraps inside, a small garden fork leaning on it and a little sprout growing at its foot; wider than tall
